note: Oman: the other GCC states' citizens move freely; New Zealanders stay 90 days without a visa, Belarus, Brunei, Kazakhstan, Russia and Türkiye 30, and the long list 14 days (with a hotel booking, insurance, a return ticket and funds); a longer stay is an e-Visa online. Nationals of the countries on the substitute list (India, Egypt, Mexico and others) may enter for 14 days only holding certain third-country visas or a GCC residence (not modelled); everyone else needs a visa. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Royal Oman Police rules. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own list, whose first group (14 days) names Mauritius, which was added, and not Taiwan (China's entry 'includes Hong Kong and Macau' only), which was moved to a visa. The Ministry gives New Zealand, Brunei, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Russia and Turkey 14 days in that group too; their longer stays rest on the bilateral agreements Wikipedia cites, not read, and were kept.

sources.said: Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Oman without a visa for the following period: Freedom of movement Bahrain Kuwait Qatar Saudi Arabia United Arab Emirates 90 days New Zealand 30 days Belarus Brunei Kazakhstan Russia Turkey 14 days All European Union member states Albania Andorra Argentina Armenia Australia Bolivia Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Canada Chile China Colombia Ecuador Georgia Hong Kong Iceland Indonesia Iran Japan Lebanon Liechtenstein Macau Malaysia Moldova Monaco North Macedonia Norway Paraguay Philippines San Marino Serbia Seychelles Singapore South Africa South Korea Suriname Switzerland Taiwan Thailand Ukraine United Kingdom United States Uruguay Uzbekistan Vatican City Venezuela

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Oman, Entry visas
sources.said: visitors from more than 100 countries and regions are exempt from entry visas for stays up to 14 days. The countries covered by this exemption are divided into two groups. First group Albania Andorra Argentina Armenia Australia Austria Belarus Belgium Bolivia Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Brunei Darussalam Bulgaria Canada Chile China (includes Hong Kong and Macau) Colombia ... Mauritius ... New Zealand ... United Kingdom United States Uruguay Uzbekistan Vatican Venezuela Second group Algeria ... Vietnam ... citizens of the second list countries are required to be either residents or have a valid entry visa for one of the following countries (the United States of America, Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, Schengen Agreement countries, Japan) ... The person will be allowed to stay in the Sultanate for a period of (14) days, which cannot be extended ... Citizens of GCC countries (the Kingdom of Bahrain, the State of Kuwait, the State of Qatar, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates) do not require visas to enter Oman.
